name: Raw order source amount
business: Raw order source amount means only SUM(orders.total_usd), expressed in USD, across all order rows at one row per order_id. Include paid and cancelled rows; status is descriptive and never restricts this population. The stored total_usd value is an opaque source amount. Its components and business calculation are not defined: do not label or infer gross revenue, net revenue, tax, discount or refund treatment. ordered_at is the order's Gregorian calendar date in UTC; month, quarter and year groupings are meaningful. order_id is an identifier. Produce no additional measures, KPIs or relationships. Missing business meaning remains unresolved outside this raw source-amount definition.

queries.question: What is the raw order source amount in USD, summing orders.total_usd across every order row including paid and cancelled orders?
queries.recorded_sql: SELECT SUM(total_usd) AS raw_source_amount FROM analytics.orders

queries.question: What is the raw order source amount in USD by UTC calendar month in 2026, including every paid and cancelled order row?
queries.recorded_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month',CAST(ordered_at AS timestamp without time zone)) AS order_month, SUM(total_usd) AS raw_source_amount FROM analytics.orders WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month',CAST(ordered_at AS timestamp without time zone)) ORDER BY order_month
